items.title: No controlled evidence for the whole protocol
items.whyItMatters: Each part has weak separate support; the combination is untested.

items.title: Ward capillary values often undocumented
items.whyItMatters: A pilot trial failed its completeness criterion for this reason (claim c2).
items.opportunity: Build a documentation check into the protocol and measure completeness.

items.title: Scheduling unavailable in orthopaedics
items.whyItMatters: The protocol must work without it for orthopaedic patients (claim c3 and the investigator's constraint).
items.opportunity: Make scheduling optional and record it.

items.title: Low meter values may be missed
items.opportunity: Confirm low values in the laboratory.

items.title: Patient experience of instructions not measured
items.whyItMatters: Conflicting instructions are what patients complain about most (claim c5).

errorsFound: Assuming a definitive trial is possible at one hospital before checking recruitment and outcome completeness.
reevaluation: The main uncertainty is whether the protocol can be delivered and measured, not yet whether it works.
summary: Five gaps: untested combination, documentation, orthopaedic scheduling, meter accuracy, and patient experience.
